definitions.gloss: photo book; photography collection; photo album (published)
definitions.explanation: A published book consisting primarily of photographs, whether art photography, landscape photography, celebrity portraits, or documentary photography.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A new photo book came out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like looking through landscape photography books.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: That idol's photo book sold out on its first day of release.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (photograph) + {集|しゅう} (collection). In Japan, celebrity {写真集|しゃしんしゅう} are a major publishing genre — idols, actors, and athletes regularly release photo books. The suffix {集|しゅう} is productive and appears in many compound nouns ({詩集|ししゅう}, ⟦{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}→短編集：28528_tanpenshuu⟧, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写真集|しゃしんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to publish a photo book
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}: landscape photography book
- {写真集|しゃしんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}れる→売れる：02012_ureru⟧: a photo book sells well

RELATED WORDS:
- フォトブック: photo book (loanword, often for personal/custom books)
- ⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧: album — broader, includes personal photo albums
- ⟦{画集|がしゅう}→画集：13709_gashuu⟧: art book; collection of paintings
